extraction.name: file_cs
extraction.prompt: Use case: background-extraction. Extract ONE approved icon from the attached design board as a production PNG asset on a genuinely TRANSPARENT background. This is a faithful isolation, NOT a redesign or a new concept. Preserve the exact silhouette, proportions, materials, colors, bevels, highlights, raised glyphs and top-left lighting of the specified large icon in the reference. Front view as shown, no new perspective. Output one centered icon only on a square canvas with a small safe transparent margin, occupying about 88% of canvas height. NO background, no checkerboard pixels baked in, no labels, no extension text under the icon, no title, no preview strip, no extra icons, no external floating shadow. Keep the icon's internal self-shading, soft bevels and internal contact shadows; silhouette edge alpha must be clean, with no dark matte halo from the charcoal reference background. Smooth UI artwork, not pixel art.Extract the LEFT large GREEN C# FILE DOCUMENT icon only. Green portrait paper silhouette with softened lower corners and a pale folded top-right corner, raised warm-ivory large C# lettering. Preserve the approved lettering precisely: capital C followed by #. Do not replace it with angle brackets, code braces, CS, or a logo badge.
